test_title: PYST 5: SSC CHSL - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: If A can complete 2/3 of a work in 60 days, then A will complete 1/5 of the same work in how many days?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**A** completes 2/3 of the **work** in 60 days.

Time to complete **Full Work (1 unit)** = 60 × 3/2 = 90 days.

Time to complete 1/5 of the **work** = 90 × 1/5 = 18 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: **A** completes 2/3 work in 60 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c18bfa223e61e5df2b28a733506114da4e615a9c01baa0f9fac9ae1aabd8d33.png] 

Formula: (**Work₁** / **Time₁**) = (**Work₂** / **Time₂**)

⇒ (2/3) / 60 = (1/5) / T₂

⇒ 2 / (3 × 60) = 1 / (5 × T₂)

⇒ 2 / 180 = 1 / (5T₂)

⇒ 1 / 90 = 1 / (5T₂)

⇒ 5T₂ = 90

⇒ T₂ = 90 ÷ 5 = 18 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work-Time Relationship

Time taken to complete a certain fraction of work is directly proportional to the work fraction. Time ∝ Work (when efficiency is constant).

Total Work Formula

If 1/n part of a work is done in T days, then the whole work is done in n × T days.

Efficiency

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Total Time. It represents the work done in a single unit of time (1 day, 1 hour, etc.).</p
